name: DocsLanding
title: Templates/Docs/Landing
summary: The documentation home, chrome included: the docs bar with a `SearchTrigger` that widens into the ⌘K field, the rail with the Getting started and Platform resources groups and the `ThemeSwitcher`, then a reading column with no outline rail. It opens on a `DocPageHeader` with no breadcrumb (the welcome title and one sentence), the Get started `Button` and a `DocPrompt` the reader hands to a coding agent. Then the entry points, each a `DocHeading` section: Start by interface (a full-width `DocCard` for agent setup over a three-column `DocCardGroup` of Console, CLI and API), Start by objective (two columns), Ready-made templates (four columns of framework glyphs, two on a phone, with an Also useful line in `DocProse`) and Follow along (release notes, blog, Discord). `DocPagination` points forward to the first page in reading order and the `Footer` closes the column. Built from `GlobalHeader`, `NavigationMenu`, `SearchTrigger`, `Sidebar`, `MenuRoot`, `ThemeSwitcher`, `ScrollArea`, `DocPageHeader`, `DocPrompt`, `DocCardGroup`, `DocCard`, `DocHeading`, `DocProse`, `DocPagination`, `Footer` and `StatusIndicator`.
